Class AxisCoupling

Namespace
TwinSharp.CNC
Assembly
TwinSharp.dll

Wraps the HLI axis coupling interface for a single CNC axis (gpAx[n].lr_mc_control.axis_coupling).

Axis coupling (electronic gearing) makes a target axis follow one or more source axes according to a specified coupling factor. Typical uses include tandem/gantry axes and secondary cutting heads (MultiJet).

Precondition: all involved axes must be at standstill (velocity = 0) before calling SetCouplings(AxisCouplingEntry[]) or RemoveCouplings(). The CNC will raise error 70200 if this is violated.

NC programmability: if the coupled target axis also needs to respond to motion commands in the NC program, include a self-coupling entry in the descriptor list (source axis = target axis, mode = Direct).

Semaphore handshake: after writing descriptors, semaphor_rw is set to true. The CNC latches the command and clears the semaphore automatically.

RemoveCouplings()

Removes all couplings from this axis by writing a single INACTIVE descriptor at index 0 and pulsing the semaphore. All involved axes must be at standstill.

public void RemoveCouplings()

SetCouplings(AxisCouplingEntry[])

Activates axis coupling with the specified descriptor list. Writes each entry's fields, writes Inactive as the terminator immediately after the last entry, then pulses the semaphore.

public void SetCouplings(AxisCouplingEntry[] specs)

Parameters

specs AxisCouplingEntry[]

Ordered list of coupling descriptors. Must not exceed HLI_AX_COUPLING_MAXIDX + 1 entries (= 4).

Exceptions

ArgumentOutOfRangeException

Thrown when specs has more than 4 entries (no room for the terminator).
